ex.en: If you don't have this software, you can download it now.
ex.zh: 如果你沒有這個軟體，現在就可以下載。

ex.en: I know that downloading music from the internet without paying is wrong, but I do it anyway.
ex.zh: 我知道從網路上免費下載音樂是不對的，但我還是照樣下載。

ex.en: When you begin downloading, please press the "Save" button.
ex.zh: 開始下載時，請按「儲存」鍵。

download.en: to copy a file from the internet to your own computer

ex.en: We bought a new domain name for the company website.
ex.zh: 我們為公司網站買了新的網域名稱。

ex.en: The email must come from our company's domain.
ex.zh: 這封信必須來自我們公司的網域。

domain.en: the address name of a website on the internet

ex.en: This question is outside my domain.
ex.zh: 這個問題不在我的專業領域。

ex.en: Medicine is no longer the domain of men.
ex.zh: 醫學不再是男性的天下。

domain.en: an area of knowledge, activity or control

ex.en: Let's have lunch downtown and take in a show.
ex.zh: 我們去市區吃午餐，順便看場表演吧。

ex.en: We are going downtown to eat pizza.
ex.zh: 我們要去市中心吃披薩。

ex.en: Where is the bus stop for downtown?
ex.zh: 往市區的公車站在哪裡？

downtown.en: in or to the main business area of a city

ex.en: The house I bought is pretty far from downtown.
ex.zh: 我買的房子離市中心滿遠的。

ex.en: She rented an apartment close to downtown.
ex.zh: 她在市中心附近租了一間公寓。

downtown.en: the main business area of a city

ex.en: The downtown area is the heart of the city.
ex.zh: 市中心是這座城市的心臟地帶。

ex.en: Our office is in a downtown building near the station.
ex.zh: 我們的辦公室在車站附近的一棟市中心大樓裡。

downtown.en: in the main business area of a city

ex.en: Cash donations will be accepted.
ex.zh: 我們接受現金捐款。

ex.en: Would the girls please bring the donation boxes up to the stage?
ex.zh: 請女孩們把捐款箱拿到台上來好嗎？

ex.en: The company made a large donation to the hospital.
ex.zh: 這家公司捐了一大筆款項給醫院。

donation.en: something, especially money, that you give to help a person or group

ex.en: How much money do you donate every year?
ex.zh: 你每年捐多少錢？

ex.en: He donated a large pile of items to the museum.
ex.zh: 他捐了一大批物品給博物館。

ex.en: Tom regularly donates money to charity.
ex.zh: 湯姆定期捐錢給慈善機構。

donate.en: to give money or goods to help a person or group

ex.en: I donate blood twice a year.
ex.zh: 我一年捐兩次血。

ex.en: She decided to donate her organs after death.
ex.zh: 她決定死後捐贈器官。

donate.en: to give blood or a body part to help sick people

ex.en: A huge tanker just pulled out from the dock.
ex.zh: 一艘巨大的油輪剛駛離碼頭。

ex.en: The huge tanker has just left the dock.
ex.zh: 那艘巨大的油輪剛離開碼頭。

ex.en: The ship is waiting at the dock to be loaded.
ex.zh: 那艘船在碼頭等著裝貨。

dock.en: a place where ships stop to load or unload

ex.en: The cruise ship docked in Keelung this morning.
ex.zh: 郵輪今天早上停靠基隆港。

ex.en: We docked at the island just before sunset.
ex.zh: 我們在日落前停靠到島上。

dock.en: to come to the place where ships stop and tie up

ex.en: They docked my pay for being late.
ex.zh: 他們因為我遲到扣了我的薪水。

ex.en: The teacher docked five points for spelling mistakes.
ex.zh: 老師因為拼字錯誤扣了五分。

dock.en: to take away part of someone's pay or points as a punishment

ex.en: I went downstairs and turned off the light.
ex.zh: 我下樓把燈關了。

ex.en: Someone is waiting for you downstairs.
ex.zh: 樓下有人在等你。

ex.en: Tom left his coat downstairs.
ex.zh: 湯姆把他的大衣忘在樓下了。

downstairs.en: on or to a lower floor of a building

ex.en: Our downstairs neighbors are very quiet.
ex.zh: 我們樓下的鄰居很安靜。

ex.en: There's a downstairs bathroom for guests.
ex.zh: 樓下有一間給客人用的浴室。

downstairs.en: on a lower floor of a building

ex.en: He recorded a documentary and gave it to me.
ex.zh: 他錄了一部紀錄片送給我。

ex.en: That documentary about the environmental crisis was a real eye-opener.
ex.zh: 那部關於環境危機的紀錄片真是讓人大開眼界。

ex.en: We watched a documentary about ocean pollution.
ex.zh: 我們看了一部關於海洋汙染的紀錄片。

documentary.en: a film or program that gives facts about real people or events

ex.en: The company lost money during the economic downturn.
ex.zh: 公司在經濟衰退期間虧了錢。

ex.en: Sales have seen a sharp downturn this quarter.
ex.zh: 這一季的銷售大幅下滑。

downturn.en: a period when business or the economy becomes weaker

ex.en: Please bring the necessary documentation to the interview.
ex.zh: 面試時請攜帶必要的證明文件。

ex.en: You'll need documentation to prove your income.
ex.zh: 你需要文件來證明你的收入。

documentation.en: papers that prove something or give official information

documentation.zh: （軟體、產品的）說明文件、技術文件

ex.en: Check the software documentation for details.
ex.zh: 詳細資訊請參考軟體說明文件。

ex.en: The documentation for this API is very clear.
ex.zh: 這個 API 的技術文件寫得很清楚。

documentation.en: written instructions that explain how a product works

ex.en: The company downsized its staff last year.
ex.zh: 公司去年裁減了人員。

ex.en: Many firms are downsizing to cut costs.
ex.zh: 許多公司為了降低成本而縮編。

downsize.en: to make a company smaller by reducing the number of workers

ex.en: Take one dose of this medicine every six hours.
ex.zh: 這個藥每六小時服用一劑。

ex.en: Do not exceed the recommended dose.
ex.zh: 請勿超過建議劑量。

ex.en: Have you had your second dose of the vaccine?
ex.zh: 你打第二劑疫苗了嗎？

dose.en: a measured amount of medicine taken at one time

ex.en: Can you save one of those donuts for me?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我留一個甜甜圈嗎？

ex.en: I want to buy a dozen donuts.
ex.zh: 我想買一打甜甜圈。

ex.en: I buy donuts every Sunday after church.
ex.zh: 我每週日做完禮拜都會買甜甜圈。

donut.en: a small, round, sweet cake with a hole in the middle

ex.en: The doorman helped us with our luggage.
ex.zh: 門房幫我們提行李。

ex.en: Our building has a doorman on duty 24 hours a day.
ex.zh: 我們大樓有門房 24 小時值班。

doorman.en: a man whose job is to stand at the entrance of a building and help people

ex.en: The company has a dominant position in the market.
ex.zh: 這家公司在市場上居主導地位。

ex.en: English is the dominant language on the internet.
ex.zh: 英文是網路上的主要語言。

dominant.en: more powerful or important than others

ex.en: You cannot be a blood donor.
ex.zh: 你不能當捐血人。

ex.en: You can't be a blood donor.
ex.zh: 你不可以捐血。

ex.en: The hospital thanked its donors for their support.
ex.zh: 醫院感謝捐款人的支持。

donor.en: a person who gives money, blood or a body part to help others

ex.en: Prices are on a downward trend.
ex.zh: 價格呈下跌趨勢。

ex.en: There is downward pressure on wages.
ex.zh: 薪資面臨下修壓力。

downward.en: moving toward a lower place or level

ex.en: The road slopes downward to the river.
ex.zh: 道路往下延伸到河邊。

ex.en: Sales figures were revised downward.
ex.zh: 銷售數字被下修了。

downward.en: toward a lower place or level

ex.en: Each religion has its own doctrine.
ex.zh: 每個宗教都有自己的教義。

ex.en: The court applied a well-known legal doctrine.
ex.zh: 法院援用了一項著名的法律原則。

doctrine.en: a set of beliefs or principles taught by a group

ex.en: She bought two pairs of polka dot stockings.
ex.zh: 她買了兩雙圓點絲襪。

ex.en: Click the three dots to see more options.
ex.zh: 點一下那三個點可以看到更多選項。

ex.en: The general meeting began at 9 am on the dot.
ex.zh: 大會在九點整準時開始。

ex.en: The train left at eight on the dot.
ex.zh: 火車在八點整準時開出。

ex.en: Small cafés dot the streets of the old town.
ex.zh: 老城區的街道上散布著小咖啡館。

ex.en: The hillside is dotted with houses.
ex.zh: 山坡上散落著一棟棟房子。

dot.en: to be spread over an area in small separate groups

ex.en: The company has kept its dominance in the market.
ex.zh: 這家公司保持了在市場上的主導地位。

ex.en: Their dominance of the smartphone market may be ending.
ex.zh: 他們在智慧型手機市場的霸主地位可能即將結束。

dominance.en: a position of more power or influence than others

ex.en: The only downside of the job is the long commute.
ex.zh: 這份工作唯一的缺點是通勤時間很長。

ex.en: What are the downsides of working from home?
ex.zh: 在家工作有哪些缺點？

downside.en: the bad part of a situation that is otherwise good

ex.en: I am doubtful whether he will come.
ex.zh: 我不確定他會不會來。

ex.en: Mrs. Harris is very doubtful about her son's future.
ex.zh: 哈里斯太太對兒子的前途很沒把握。

ex.en: It is doubtful that the project will finish on time.
ex.zh: 這個專案能否準時完成很難說。

ex.en: The bad weather makes the outdoor event doubtful.
ex.zh: 天氣不好，戶外活動能不能辦成還不確定。

doubtful.en: not likely to happen or be true

ex.en: The agency downgraded the country's credit rating.
ex.zh: 評等機構調降了該國的信用評等。

ex.en: My ticket was downgraded to economy class.
ex.zh: 我的機票被降到經濟艙。

downgrade.en: to move someone or something to a lower level

ex.en: The downgrade caused the stock to fall.
ex.zh: 評等調降導致股價下跌。

ex.en: Many users see the new version as a downgrade.
ex.zh: 很多使用者覺得新版本反而變差了。

downgrade.en: a move to a lower level or rank

doom.zh: 注定（失敗等），常用 be doomed

ex.en: Everyone is doomed to die.
ex.zh: 每個人終究難逃一死。

ex.en: The plan was doomed from the start.
ex.zh: 這個計畫從一開始就注定失敗。

ex.en: Without funding, the project is doomed to fail.
ex.zh: 沒有資金，這個專案注定會失敗。

doom.en: to make someone certain to fail, suffer or die

doom.zh: 厄運、毀滅；doom and gloom 悲觀氣氛

ex.en: I had a sense of doom before the exam.
ex.zh: 考試前我有種大難臨頭的感覺。

ex.en: Despite all the doom and gloom, sales improved.
ex.zh: 儘管一片悲觀，銷售還是好轉了。

doom.en: a terrible future event that cannot be avoided

ex.en: I couldn't have done it without you. Thank you.
ex.zh: 沒有你我做不到，謝謝。

ex.en: What on earth are you doing in my room?
ex.zh: 你到底在我房間裡做什麼？

do.en: to carry out an action or job

do.zh: （助動詞）構成疑問句、否定句；加強語氣

ex.en: What time does the train for New York depart?
ex.zh: 去紐約的火車幾點出發？

ex.en: Do you take credit cards?
ex.zh: 你們收信用卡嗎？

do.en: used with another verb to ask questions, make negatives or add emphasis

ex.en: How did you do on the exam?
ex.zh: 你考試考得怎麼樣？

ex.en: The company is doing well this year.
ex.zh: 公司今年營運狀況很好。

do.en: to get along or make progress, well or badly

ex.en: Any pen will do.
ex.zh: 任何筆都可以。

ex.en: Will $20 do?
ex.zh: 二十塊夠嗎？

do.en: to be good enough for a purpose

ex.en: I'll do my best not to disturb your studying.
ex.zh: 我會盡量不打擾你唸書。

ex.en: Just do your best on the test.
ex.zh: 考試盡力就好。

do.en: to try as hard as you can

ex.en: Please sit down.
ex.zh: 請坐。

ex.en: Prices went down last month.
ex.zh: 上個月價格下跌了。

down.en: toward or at a lower place or level

down.zh: write down / note down：寫下、記下

ex.en: The students noted down every word the teacher said.
ex.zh: 學生們把老師說的每個字都記了下來。

ex.en: Let me write down your number.
ex.zh: 我把你的電話號碼記下來。

down.en: to put words on paper so you can remember them

ex.en: The car broke down after half an hour's driving.
ex.zh: 車子開了半小時就拋錨了。

ex.en: My computer broke down again.
ex.zh: 我的電腦又壞了。

down.en: to stop working because of a fault

ex.en: Possibly the factory will be closed down next week.
ex.zh: 工廠下週可能會關閉。

ex.en: The store closed down last year.
ex.zh: 那家店去年歇業了。

ex.en: His life was full of ups and downs.
ex.zh: 他的人生充滿起起落落。

ex.en: Life is full of ups and downs.
ex.zh: 人生充滿起伏。

down.en: a mix of good and bad times

ex.en: When I opened the door, I found him asleep.
ex.zh: 我打開門時，發現他睡著了。

ex.en: The doors on the left side will open.
ex.zh: 左側車門即將開啟。

ex.en: We lock the doors at night.
ex.zh: 我們晚上會鎖門。

door.en: a piece of wood or glass you open to enter a room or building

ex.en: The family next door just moved in.
ex.zh: 隔壁那家人剛搬進來。

ex.en: There is a coffee shop next door to my office.
ex.zh: 我辦公室隔壁有家咖啡店。

door.en: in the next house or room

ex.en: They regarded him as the best doctor in town.
ex.zh: 他們認為他是鎮上最好的醫生。

ex.en: Are there any doctors here who can speak Japanese?
ex.zh: 這裡有會說日文的醫生嗎？

ex.en: The doctor thought the patient's pulse was rather rapid.
ex.zh: 醫生覺得病人的脈搏有點快。

doctor.en: a person trained to treat sick or hurt people

ex.en: You should see a doctor about that cough.
ex.zh: 你那個咳嗽應該去看醫生。

ex.en: I went to see a doctor yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天去看了醫生。

doctor.en: to visit a medical person for advice about your health

ex.en: I have serious doubts about their plans succeeding.
ex.zh: 我很懷疑他們的計畫能不能成功。

ex.en: In a way you're right, but I still have doubts.
ex.zh: 從某方面來說你是對的，但我還是有疑慮。

ex.en: There is no doubt that she is the best candidate.
ex.zh: 毫無疑問，她是最佳人選。

doubt.en: a feeling of not being sure about something

ex.en: I began to doubt the accuracy of his statement.
ex.zh: 我開始懷疑他說法的正確性。

ex.en: I doubt that he will come today.
ex.zh: 我不認為他今天會來。

doubt.en: to think that something is probably not true

ex.en: A dog can run faster than a man can.
ex.zh: 狗跑得比人快。

ex.en: I am not in the least afraid of dogs.
ex.zh: 我一點也不怕狗。

ex.en: We have two dogs, three cats, and six chickens.
ex.zh: 我們養了兩隻狗、三隻貓和六隻雞。

dog.en: a common animal kept as a pet or used for work

ex.en: I would like to borrow fifty dollars from you.
ex.zh: 我想跟你借五十元。

ex.en: We have a single for 50 dollars per night.
ex.zh: 我們有一間一晚五十美元的單人房。

ex.en: The Taiwanese dollar appreciated, causing Taiwanese exports to slump.
ex.zh: 新台幣升值，導致台灣出口衰退。

dollar.en: the main unit of money in the United States and some other countries

ex.en: The population has doubled in the last five years.
ex.zh: 過去五年人口增加了一倍。

ex.en: The price of coffee has doubled since then.
ex.zh: 從那時起，咖啡的價格翻了一倍。

ex.en: I'm doubling my prices.
ex.zh: 我要把價格提高一倍。

double.en: to become twice as big, or to make something twice as big

ex.en: I'd like to book a double room for two nights.
ex.zh: 我想訂一間雙人房，住兩晚。

ex.en: Please double-check the figures before you send the report.
ex.zh: 寄出報告前請再檢查一次數字。

double.en: twice as much, or made for two people

ex.en: The price is double what it was last year.
ex.zh: 價格是去年的兩倍。

ex.en: Prices are double what they were ten years ago.
ex.zh: 物價是十年前的兩倍。

double.en: an amount that is twice as large

ex.en: Domestic flights leave from Terminal 1.
ex.zh: 國內航班從第一航廈出發。

ex.en: The company focuses on the domestic market.
ex.zh: 這家公司專注於國內市場。

ex.en: Domestic sales rose by 5% this year.
ex.zh: 今年國內銷售成長了 5%。

ex.en: I wrote a post to my blog encouraging men to report experiences with domestic abuse.
ex.zh: 我在部落格上發文，鼓勵男性說出自己遭受家暴的經歷。

ex.en: She shares the domestic chores with her husband.
ex.zh: 她和先生分擔家務。

domestic.en: relating to the home or family

ex.en: I buy the goods at $3 a dozen.
ex.zh: 我以一打三美元的價格買下這些東西。

ex.en: About a dozen trees had soon been planted.
ex.zh: 大約十二棵樹很快就種好了。

ex.en: I bought a dozen eggs.
ex.zh: 我買了一打雞蛋。

ex.en: I've been there dozens of times.
ex.zh: 我去過那裡幾十次了。

ex.en: Dozens of people were waiting in line.
ex.zh: 有幾十個人在排隊。

ex.en: A few large companies dominate the market.
ex.zh: 少數幾家大公司主導了市場。

ex.en: He tends to dominate every meeting.
ex.zh: 他往往在每場會議中主導發言。

dominate.en: to have the most power or influence over others

ex.en: Smartphones dominate our daily lives.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機主宰了我們的日常生活。

ex.en: Sports news dominated the headlines this week.
ex.zh: 這週的頭條幾乎都是體育新聞。

dominate.en: to be the most important or noticeable part of something

ex.en: The company has achieved market domination.
ex.zh: 這家公司已經主導市場。

ex.en: Their domination of the tournament continued for years.
ex.zh: 他們稱霸這項錦標賽好多年。

doggy bag.zh: 打包剩菜的袋子（餐廳提供）

ex.en: I think we need a doggy bag.
ex.zh: 看來我們得打包了。

ex.en: Could I get a doggy bag for the rest of my pasta?
ex.zh: 我剩下的義大利麵可以打包嗎？

doggy bag.en: a bag in which a restaurant customer takes home leftover food

ex.en: Don't take more than the recommended dosage.
ex.zh: 不要超過建議劑量。

ex.en: The dosage for children is half a tablet.
ex.zh: 兒童的劑量是半顆。

dosage.en: the amount of medicine to take and how often

ex.en: She received a doctorate.
ex.zh: 她取得了博士學位。

ex.en: She earned her doctorate in public health last year.
ex.zh: 她去年取得了公共衛生博士學位。

ex.en: He is working on a doctorate in medicine.
ex.zh: 他正在攻讀醫學博士學位。

ex.en: My uncle is so dogmatic that he never listens to other opinions.
ex.zh: 我叔叔非常武斷，從不聽別人的意見。

ex.en: Good teachers are open-minded rather than dogmatic.
ex.zh: 好老師心胸開放，而不是死守教條。

dogmatic.en: sure that your beliefs are right and not open to other opinions

ex.en: I attached my signature to the document.
ex.zh: 我在文件上簽了名。

ex.en: He was forced to sign the document.
ex.zh: 他被迫在文件上簽字。

ex.en: Father translated the French document into Japanese.
ex.zh: 爸爸把那份法文文件翻成了日文。

document.en: a paper or computer file with official or written information

ex.en: Please document every step of the process.
ex.zh: 請把流程的每個步驟都記錄下來。

ex.en: The film documents the life of a famous chef.
ex.zh: 這部片記錄了一位知名主廚的生活。

document.en: to write down or record facts about something

ex.en: Regular maintenance helps reduce machine downtime.
ex.zh: 定期保養有助於減少機器停機時間。

ex.en: The system upgrade caused two hours of downtime.
ex.zh: 系統升級造成兩小時的停機時間。

downtime.en: a period when a machine or system is not working

ex.en: We saved for three years to make the down payment on our home.
ex.zh: 我們存了三年，才付得起買房的頭期款。

ex.en: A larger down payment can reduce the monthly mortgage bill.
ex.zh: 提高頭期款可降低每月房貸金額。

down payment.en: the first part of the price paid when buying something expensive

ex.en: The courier left the parcel on the doorstep as requested.
ex.zh: 快遞依照要求把包裹放在門口。

ex.en: A welcome mat was placed on the doorstep.
ex.zh: 門階上放了一張迎賓地墊。

doorstep.en: the step in front of the door of a house

ex.en: Do you have a double room?
ex.zh: 請問有沒有雙人房？

ex.en: Single or double room?
ex.zh: 單人房還是雙人房?

ex.en: I would like a less expensive double room.
ex.zh: 我想要便宜一點的雙人房。

double room.en: a hotel room for two people

ex.en: A little cat was sitting in the doorway of the shop.
ex.zh: 一隻小貓坐在店門口。

ex.en: He stood in the doorway and waved goodbye.
ex.zh: 他站在門口揮手道別。

ex.en: She sleeps with her favorite doll every night.
ex.zh: 她每晚都抱著最喜歡的洋娃娃睡覺。

ex.en: The girl made a small dress for her doll.
ex.zh: 女孩為她的洋娃娃做了一件小洋裝。

ex.en: A dolphin jumped out of the water right next to our boat.
ex.zh: 一隻海豚在我們的船旁邊躍出水面。

ex.en: Dolphins are very smart and like to play with people.
ex.zh: 海豚非常聰明，也喜歡和人玩耍。

ex.en: Knead the dough for ten minutes until it is smooth.
ex.zh: 把麵糰揉十分鐘，直到變得光滑。

ex.en: Let the dough rest for an hour before baking.
ex.zh: 烘烤前先讓麵糰靜置一個小時。

ex.en: Douglas takes the train to work every day.
ex.zh: 道格拉斯每天搭火車上班。

ex.en: We invited Douglas to join our book club.
ex.zh: 我們邀請道格拉斯加入我們的讀書會。

ex.en: Donald is a common name for boys in English-speaking countries.
ex.zh: 唐納德是英語系國家常見的男孩名字。

ex.en: Donald Duck is a famous cartoon character.
ex.zh: 唐老鴨是著名的卡通角色。

ex.en: The firefighters donned their helmets and jackets.
ex.zh: 消防員穿上了頭盔和外套。

ex.en: He donned a warm coat before going outside.
ex.zh: 他出門前穿上了一件保暖的外套。

ex.en: In Spain, a gentleman may be addressed as Don.
ex.zh: 在西班牙，對紳士可以用 Don 來稱呼。

ex.en: Don Quixote is the title of a famous Spanish novel.
ex.zh: 《唐吉訶德》是一部著名西班牙小說的書名。

ex.en: The old church has a beautiful blue dome.
ex.zh: 那座老教堂有一個美麗的藍色圓頂。

ex.en: Tourists climbed to the top of the dome to see the city.
ex.zh: 遊客爬到圓頂頂端俯瞰整座城市。

ex.en: The stadium has a huge dome that covers the whole field.
ex.zh: 那座體育館有個巨大的圓頂，覆蓋了整個球場。

ex.en: Dorothy grows roses in her small backyard.
ex.zh: 桃樂絲在她的小後院裡種玫瑰。

ex.en: Dorothy always remembers everyone's birthday.
ex.zh: 桃樂絲總是記得每個人的生日。

ex.en: What are you doing this weekend?
ex.zh: 你這個週末要做什麼？

ex.en: He is doing his homework at the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 他正在廚房的桌子上寫功課。

ex.en: The mess in the kitchen is all your doing.
ex.zh: 廚房這一團亂都是你搞出來的。

ex.en: It was none of my doing that the meeting ran late.
ex.zh: 會議拖延不是我造成的。

ex.en: She will doubtless pass the exam because she studied so hard.
ex.zh: 她那麼用功，想必會通過考試。

ex.en: Doubtless you are tired after such a long flight.
ex.zh: 搭了這麼長的飛行，你想必累了。

ex.en: He is doubtless the best player on our team.
ex.zh: 他無疑是我們隊上最好的球員。

ex.en: It is doubtless that the weather will get colder next week.
ex.zh: 下週天氣會變冷是毫無疑問的。

ex.en: The doubtless success of the show surprised no one.
ex.zh: 這場演出毫無疑問的成功並沒有讓任何人意外。

ex.en: Doug is short for Douglas.
ex.zh: Doug 是 Douglas 的簡稱。

ex.en: Doug fixed the fence over the weekend.
ex.zh: 道格週末把圍籬修好了。

ex.en: The path slopes gently downwards to the river.
ex.zh: 這條小路緩緩向下通往河邊。

ex.en: She pointed her finger downwards and said, "Look at the floor."
ex.zh: 她手指向下指說：「看地板。」

ex.en: He jumped aside to dodge the speeding bike.
ex.zh: 他跳向一旁閃開疾駛而來的自行車。

ex.en: The politician tried to dodge the reporter's question.
ex.zh: 那位政治人物試圖迴避記者的問題。

ex.en: Using a fake name was a clever dodge to avoid the crowds.
ex.zh: 用假名是個避開人群的聰明花招。

ex.en: It was just a dodge to get out of paying.
ex.zh: 那只是想逃避付錢的伎倆。

ex.en: The farmer used a donkey to carry the heavy bags.
ex.zh: 農夫用驢子來馱重的袋子。

ex.en: The children enjoyed riding the donkey around the yard.
ex.zh: 孩子們很喜歡騎著驢子繞院子。

ex.en: A white dove sat on the fence.
ex.zh: 一隻白鴿停在籬笆上。

ex.en: The dove is often a symbol of peace.
ex.zh: 鴿子常被當作和平的象徵。

dove.zh: dive 的過去式（跳水；潛入）

ex.en: He dove into the pool without hesitation.
ex.zh: 他毫不猶豫地跳進泳池。

ex.en: The bird dove down to catch a fish.
ex.zh: 那隻鳥俯衝下去抓魚。

ex.en: She is writing her doctoral thesis on climate change.
ex.zh: 她正在寫關於氣候變遷的博士論文。

ex.en: He applied for a doctoral program in physics.
ex.zh: 他申請了物理學的博士班。

ex.en: The Dominican Republic is famous for its beautiful beaches.
ex.zh: 多明尼加共和國以美麗的海灘聞名。

ex.en: We tried some delicious Dominican food at the street festival.
ex.zh: 我們在街頭慶典上嚐了一些好吃的多明尼加料理。

ex.en: I share a dorm room with two other students.
ex.zh: 我和另外兩位學生共用一間宿舍。

ex.en: The dorm is only a five-minute walk from the classroom.
ex.zh: 宿舍離教室走路只要五分鐘。

dover.zh: 多佛（英國東南部的港口城市）

ex.en: Dover is a port town on the southeast coast of England.
ex.zh: 多佛是英格蘭東南海岸的一座港口城鎮。

ex.en: Ferries run between Dover and the French port of Calais.
ex.zh: 渡輪往返於多佛和法國的加萊港之間。

ex.en: He was on the dole for six months after losing his job.
ex.zh: 他失業後領了半年的失業救濟金。

ex.en: Many people lived on the dole during the recession.
ex.zh: 衰退期間許多人靠失業救濟金過活。

ex.en: The volunteers doled out soup to the hungry.
ex.zh: 志工們把湯分給飢餓的人。

ex.en: The teacher doled out the worksheets to each row.
ex.zh: 老師把練習卷分發給每一排。

ex.en: A doe and her fawn walked out of the forest.
ex.zh: 一隻母鹿帶著小鹿走出森林。

ex.en: We saw a doe eating grass near the road.
ex.zh: 我們看見一隻母鹿在路邊吃草。

ex.en: The little girl carried her dolly everywhere she went.
ex.zh: 小女孩不管去哪裡都帶著她的洋娃娃。

ex.en: Grandma sewed a new dress for the dolly.
ex.zh: 奶奶為洋娃娃縫了一件新洋裝。

ex.en: The movers used a dolly to carry the heavy boxes.
ex.zh: 搬家工人用手推台車搬運沉重的箱子。

ex.en: The camera sat on a dolly so it could glide smoothly across the set.
ex.zh: 攝影機放在移動車上，能在片場平順地滑動。

ex.en: I had a chocolate doughnut and coffee for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我早餐吃了一個巧克力甜甜圈配咖啡。

ex.en: She bought a dozen doughnuts for the office.
ex.zh: 她為辦公室買了一打甜甜圈。

ex.en: The bike rolled downhill without anyone pedaling.
ex.zh: 腳踏車沒人踩就自己滑下坡。

ex.en: We walked downhill for an hour to reach the village.
ex.zh: 我們往山下走了一小時才到村子。

ex.en: The last part of the trail is an easy downhill walk.
ex.zh: 步道的最後一段是輕鬆的下坡路。

ex.en: He won the downhill ski race this weekend.
ex.zh: 他贏得了這個週末的滑降滑雪比賽。

ex.en: Things went downhill after the new boss arrived.
ex.zh: 新老闆一來，情況就每況愈下。

ex.en: His health started to go downhill last winter.
ex.zh: 他的健康從去年冬天起就開始走下坡。

ex.en: You should be doubly careful on icy roads.
ex.zh: 在結冰的路上你應該加倍小心。

ex.en: I was doubly pleased to see both of my friends there.
ex.zh: 看到兩位朋友都在場，我加倍高興。

ex.en: The company tried to downplay the problem.
ex.zh: 公司試圖淡化這個問題。

ex.en: She downplayed her success and said she was just lucky.
ex.zh: 她輕描淡寫自己的成功，說只是運氣好。

ex.en: Doctors should not downplay a patient's pain.
ex.zh: 醫生不應該輕忽病人的疼痛。

ex.en: The boat drifted downstream with the current.
ex.zh: 小船順著水流往下游漂去。

ex.en: We followed the river downstream for about an hour.
ex.zh: 我們沿著河流往下游走了大約一小時。

ex.en: Farms downstream were affected by the polluted water.
ex.zh: 下游的農田受到汙水影響。

ex.en: The downstream towns were warned about the flood.
ex.zh: 下游的城鎮接獲了洪水警告。

ex.en: The king held dominion over a large part of the continent.
ex.zh: 那位國王統治著這塊大陸的大部分地區。

ex.en: Humans have long claimed dominion over the animals.
ex.zh: 人類長久以來宣稱自己支配著動物。

ex.en: The island was once a dominion of the British Empire.
ex.zh: 這座島曾是大英帝國的自治領。

ex.en: The ruler's dominion stretched from the coast to the mountains.
ex.zh: 統治者的領土從海岸綿延到山區。

ex.en: I have an appointment with the doc this afternoon.
ex.zh: 我今天下午跟醫生有約。

ex.en: The doc told me to rest and drink more water.
ex.zh: 醫生叫我多休息、多喝水。

ex.en: Please save the doc before closing your laptop.
ex.zh: 關上筆電前請先儲存文件。

ex.en: I sent you the doc by email this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上用電子郵件把文件寄給你了。

ex.en: Doncaster is a town in South Yorkshire, England.
ex.zh: 唐卡斯特是英格蘭南約克郡的一座城鎮。

ex.en: We changed trains at Doncaster on our way north.
ex.zh: 我們北上途中在唐卡斯特換了火車。

ex.en: The weather today is downright freezing.
ex.zh: 今天的天氣簡直冷死人了。

ex.en: It was downright rude to ignore her question.
ex.zh: 無視她的問題簡直就是無禮。

ex.en: That was a downright lie.
ex.zh: 那完全是謊話。

ex.en: The service at the hotel was a downright disgrace.
ex.zh: 那家飯店的服務簡直是恥辱。

ex.en: My brother lives in the university dormitory.
ex.zh: 我哥哥住在大學宿舍。

ex.en: Each room in the dormitory has two beds.
ex.zh: 宿舍裡的每個房間都有兩張床。

ex.en: The shark's dorsal fin rose above the water.
ex.zh: 鯊魚的背鰭露出水面。

ex.en: The dorsal side of the fish is darker than its belly.
ex.zh: 魚的背側比腹部顏色深。

ex.en: The scandal led to the minister's downfall.
ex.zh: 那起醜聞導致部長下台。

ex.en: The empire's downfall came after years of war.
ex.zh: 這個帝國在多年戰爭後走向衰亡。

ex.en: Pride was his downfall.
ex.zh: 驕傲就是他失敗的原因。

ex.en: Overspending was the downfall of the small business.
ex.zh: 過度花費是這家小生意倒閉的原因。

ex.en: The volcano has been dormant for hundreds of years.
ex.zh: 這座火山已經休眠數百年。

ex.en: Many seeds stay dormant until spring arrives.
ex.zh: 許多種子會一直休眠到春天來臨。

ex.en: Grandpa dozed in his chair after lunch.
ex.zh: 爺爺午餐後在椅子上打瞌睡。

ex.en: I dozed off during the long lecture.
ex.zh: 漫長的演講中我打起了瞌睡。

ex.en: He had a short doze on the train.
ex.zh: 他在火車上小睡了一下。

ex.en: A quick doze in the afternoon helps me focus.
ex.zh: 下午打個小盹能讓我更專心。

ex.en: He refused to accept political dogma without question.
ex.zh: 他不肯不加質疑地接受政治教條。

ex.en: Scientists should not follow dogma when the evidence says otherwise.
ex.zh: 證據顯示不同時，科學家不該死守教條。

ex.en: The doorbell rang just as we sat down to eat.
ex.zh: 我們剛坐下來吃飯，門鈴就響了。

ex.en: Please press the doorbell twice if nobody answers.
ex.zh: 如果沒人回應，請按兩次門鈴。

ex.en: I bought a dodgy used phone and it broke in a week.
ex.zh: 我買了一支來路不明的二手手機，一週就壞了。

ex.en: The deal sounded dodgy, so we walked away.
ex.zh: 這筆交易聽起來可疑，所以我們沒做。

ex.en: Dominic is a boy's name that comes from Latin.
ex.zh: 多米尼克是源自拉丁文的男子名。

ex.en: Dominic offered to carry our bags to the car.
ex.zh: 多米尼克主動幫我們把行李搬到車上。

ex.en: The product is made domestically, not imported.
ex.zh: 這項產品是在國內製造的，不是進口的。

ex.en: The company sells most of its goods domestically.
ex.zh: 這家公司大部分的商品都在國內銷售。

ex.en: The two churches have a doctrinal disagreement.
ex.zh: 這兩個教會在教義上有分歧。

ex.en: They argued over doctrinal matters for hours.
ex.zh: 他們為教義方面的問題爭論了好幾個小時。

ex.en: Firefighters doused the flames with water.
ex.zh: 消防員用水撲滅了火焰。

ex.en: He doused the campfire before going to sleep.
ex.zh: 他睡前把營火澆熄了。

ex.en: He lined up a hundred dominoes on the floor.
ex.zh: 他在地上排了一百張骨牌。

ex.en: The last domino fell and the whole line collapsed.
ex.zh: 最後一張骨牌倒下，整排都垮了。

ex.en: The doorknob came off in my hand.
ex.zh: 門把在我手中掉了下來。

ex.en: Please wipe the doorknob with a clean cloth.
ex.zh: 請用乾淨的布擦拭門把。

ex.en: The doubling of prices surprised everyone in town.
ex.zh: 物價漲了一倍，讓鎮上每個人都很驚訝。

ex.en: Doubling the recipe will take twice as much flour.
ex.zh: 把食譜份量加倍就需要兩倍的麵粉。

ex.en: The dour old man never smiled at the neighbors.
ex.zh: 那位陰沉的老先生從來不對鄰居微笑。

ex.en: Her dour expression made everyone nervous.
ex.zh: 她陰沉的表情讓大家都很緊張。

documented.zh: 有文件記載的；有紀錄的

ex.en: It is a well documented fact that exercise helps sleep.
ex.zh: 運動有助睡眠是個有充分記錄的事實。

ex.en: The museum keeps a documented history of every painting.
ex.zh: 博物館保存著每幅畫的完整紀錄。

documented.zh: 記錄（document 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: She documented every step of the experiment.
ex.zh: 她記錄了實驗的每個步驟。

ex.en: The reporter documented life in the small village.
ex.zh: 記者記錄了小村莊的生活。

ex.en: She wore a dotted dress to the party.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件圓點洋裝去參加派對。

ex.en: The sky was dotted with tiny stars.
ex.zh: 天空點綴著小小的星星。

ex.en: Sign your name on the dotted line.
ex.zh: 在虛線上簽名。

ex.en: The dotted line on the map shows the hiking trail.
ex.zh: 地圖上的虛線是登山步道。

ex.en: In the old story, the bride's father prepared a generous dowry.
ex.zh: 在那個古老的故事裡，新娘的父親準備了豐厚的嫁妝。

ex.en: Her grandmother kept a silver tea set as part of her dowry.
ex.zh: 她的祖母把一套銀茶具留作嫁妝的一部分。

ex.en: The dogwood in our yard blooms every spring.
ex.zh: 我們院子裡的山茱萸每年春天都會開花。

ex.en: White dogwood flowers covered the hillside in April.
ex.zh: 四月時，白色的山茱萸花開滿了山坡。

ex.en: Dogs were among the first domesticated animals.
ex.zh: 狗是最早被馴養的動物之一。

ex.en: Wild horses are harder to ride than domesticated ones.
ex.zh: 野馬比馴養過的馬更難騎。

domesticated.zh: 馴化（domesticate 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: People domesticated wheat thousands of years ago.
ex.zh: 人類在數千年前就把小麥馴化成農作物。

ex.en: The farmers domesticated wild goats for their milk.
ex.zh: 農夫為了取得羊奶而馴養野山羊。

ex.en: Workers repaired the ship at the dockyard.
ex.zh: 工人們在造船廠修理那艘船。

ex.en: The old dockyard is now a museum.
ex.zh: 那座舊船塢現在成了博物館。

ex.en: We were caught in a sudden downpour without umbrellas.
ex.zh: 我們沒帶傘就遇上了一場傾盆大雨。

ex.en: The downpour flooded several streets.
ex.zh: 這場大雨淹沒了好幾條街。

ex.en: My grandfather worked as a docker for thirty years.
ex.zh: 我祖父當了三十年的碼頭工人。

ex.en: The dockers went on strike over their working hours.
ex.zh: 碼頭工人為了工時問題罷工。

ex.en: The project was doomed from the start.
ex.zh: 這個計畫從一開始就註定失敗。

ex.en: Everyone knew the old shop was doomed to close.
ex.zh: 大家都知道那家老店註定要關門。

ex.en: She added a dollop of cream to the soup.
ex.zh: 她在湯裡加了一球鮮奶油。

ex.en: He put a big dollop of mashed potato on my plate.
ex.zh: 他在我盤子裡舀了一大坨馬鈴薯泥。

ex.en: The old preacher spoke about Domesday and the end of the world.
ex.zh: 老牧師談到末日審判與世界的終結。

ex.en: The Domesday Book is a famous survey of England from medieval times.
ex.zh: 《末日審判書》是英格蘭中世紀一份著名的調查紀錄。

ex.en: She looked at the old bridge doubtfully before crossing.
ex.zh: 她過橋前懷疑地看著那座舊橋。

ex.en: "Will it work?" he asked doubtfully.
ex.zh: 「這樣行得通嗎？」他半信半疑地問。

ex.en: The docking of the ferry took about ten minutes.
ex.zh: 渡輪靠岸大約花了十分鐘。

ex.en: The astronauts prepared for the docking with the space station.
ex.zh: 太空人為與太空站的對接做準備。

downsizing.zh: 縮減規模（downsize 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The company is downsizing its main office to save money.
ex.zh: 公司正在縮減總部的規模以節省開支。

ex.en: They are downsizing to a smaller apartment after the kids moved out.
ex.zh: 孩子搬出去後，他們打算換到較小的公寓。

ex.en: Please write your permanent domicile on the form.
ex.zh: 請在表格上填寫你的永久住所。

ex.en: His legal domicile is in Tainan.
ex.zh: 他的法定住所在台南。

ex.en: The family was domiciled in Kaohsiung for many years.
ex.zh: 這家人在高雄定居了許多年。

ex.en: He domiciled himself in a small mountain town.
ex.zh: 他在一個山中小鎮定居下來。

downed.zh: 一口喝光（down 的過去式）

ex.en: He downed his coffee and ran out the door.
ex.zh: 他一口喝完咖啡就衝出門。

ex.en: She downed a glass of water after the race.
ex.zh: 比賽結束後，她一口氣喝下一杯水。

ex.en: The storm downed several trees along the road.
ex.zh: 暴風雨吹倒了路邊的好幾棵樹。

ex.en: The boxer downed his opponent in the second round.
ex.zh: 拳擊手在第二回合就把對手擊倒了。

ex.en: Finishing the project by Friday is doable if we all help.
ex.zh: 如果大家都幫忙，星期五前完成這個專案是做得到的。

ex.en: The plan sounds big, but it's actually doable.
ex.zh: 這個計畫聽起來很龐大，但其實是可行的。

ex.en: Is a ten-kilometer hike doable for a beginner?
ex.zh: 對初學者來說，十公里的健行辦得到嗎？

ex.en: The horse is docile enough for children to ride.
ex.zh: 這匹馬溫馴到小孩都能騎。

ex.en: Our cat is docile and never scratches anyone.
ex.zh: 我們的貓很溫順，從不抓人。

ex.en: The students were docile and followed every instruction.
ex.zh: 學生們很乖順，照著每項指示去做。

ex.en: Her dogged effort finally led to success.
ex.zh: 她頑強的努力終於帶來了成功。

ex.en: The team showed dogged determination in the final game.
ex.zh: 球隊在最後一場比賽中展現了不屈不撓的決心。

ex.en: The old church has a large domed roof.
ex.zh: 這座老教堂有一個巨大的圓頂。

ex.en: We visited a domed stadium in the city.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了城裡一座圓頂體育館。

ex.en: The judge has a full docket of cases this week.
ex.zh: 法官這星期的待審案件表已排得滿滿的。

ex.en: Our case is on the court docket for Monday morning.
ex.zh: 我們的案子排在星期一早上的法庭審理名單上。

ex.en: We camped downwind of the fire so the smoke blew away from us.
ex.zh: 我們在營火的下風處紮營，這樣煙就會往別處吹。

ex.en: The sailors drifted downwind toward the island.
ex.zh: 水手們順著風向飄向那座島。

ex.en: The farm lies in the downwind direction from the factory.
ex.zh: 這座農場位在工廠的下風處。

ex.en: Residents downwind of the fire were told to stay indoors.
ex.zh: 火場下風處的居民被告知要待在室內。

ex.en: She doggedly pursued her dream of becoming a doctor.
ex.zh: 她鍥而不捨地追求成為醫師的夢想。

ex.en: The runner doggedly kept going despite the pain.
ex.zh: 儘管疼痛，那位跑者仍頑強地繼續跑。

ex.en: The newspaper reported on the doings of the town council.
ex.zh: 報紙報導了市議會的各項活動。

ex.en: I heard about your strange doings last night.
ex.zh: 我聽說了你昨晚的古怪舉動。

ex.en: She enjoyed the quiet domesticity of her small home.
ex.zh: 她很享受自己小家安靜的家居生活。

ex.en: He gave up work for a life of domesticity.
ex.zh: 他放棄工作，過起居家生活。

ex.en: The police kept a thick dossier on the case.
ex.zh: 警方保存了一份厚厚的案件卷宗。

ex.en: She prepared a dossier on each job candidate.
ex.zh: 她為每位求職者準備了一份檔案。

ex.en: The athlete was banned for doping.
ex.zh: 那位運動員因為使用禁藥而被禁賽。

ex.en: Strict tests have been introduced to fight doping in sports.
ex.zh: 為了打擊運動中的禁藥問題，已引進嚴格的檢驗。

ex.en: Every doubter was surprised when the plan worked.
ex.zh: 當計畫成功時，每個持懷疑態度的人都很驚訝。

ex.en: She proved the doubters wrong by finishing the race.
ex.zh: 她完成了比賽，證明那些懷疑者錯了。

donated.zh: 捐贈（donate 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: She donated her old books to the local library.
ex.zh: 她把舊書捐給了當地圖書館。

ex.en: Many people donated blood after the accident.
ex.zh: 意外發生後，許多人捐了血。

ex.en: Please wipe your shoes on the doormat before you come in.
ex.zh: 進門前請先在門口地墊上擦鞋。

ex.en: She left the spare key under the doormat.
ex.zh: 她把備用鑰匙放在門口地墊下面。

ex.en: Stop being a doormat and tell them what you really think.
ex.zh: 別再當個任人欺負的人，告訴他們你真正的想法吧。

ex.en: He felt like a doormat because everyone walked all over him.
ex.zh: 他覺得自己像塊踏墊，大家都欺負他。

ex.en: Some people believed that doomsday would arrive that year.
ex.zh: 有些人相信世界末日會在那一年降臨。

ex.en: The movie is about scientists trying to stop a doomsday event.
ex.zh: 這部電影講的是科學家努力阻止一場末日浩劫。

ex.en: My dotty old aunt talks to her plants every morning.
ex.zh: 我那古怪的老姑姑每天早上都對她的植物說話。

ex.en: It sounds like a dotty idea, but it might work.
ex.zh: 這聽起來是個傻氣的主意，但也許行得通。

ex.en: Grandparents often dote on their grandchildren.
ex.zh: 祖父母常常溺愛孫子孫女。

ex.en: He dotes on his little daughter and buys her everything.
ex.zh: 他很疼愛他的小女兒，什麼都買給她。

ex.en: I can't do without my morning coffee.
ex.zh: 我沒有早晨那杯咖啡就不行。

ex.en: They had to do without electricity for two days after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨過後，他們有兩天得在沒有電的情況下過日子。

ex.en: If we don't have a car, we'll just do without.
ex.zh: 如果沒有車，我們就將就著過。

ex.en: The teacher made me do the report over.
ex.zh: 老師要我把報告重做一遍。

ex.en: I messed up, so I have to do it over.
ex.zh: 我搞砸了，所以得重做。

ex.en: Can we do over the first part of the song?
ex.zh: 我們能把這首歌的第一段重來一次嗎？

do over.en: to do something again from the beginning

ex.en: The school decided to do away with the uniform rule.
ex.zh: 學校決定廢除制服規定。

ex.en: We should do away with these old forms and use apps.
ex.zh: 我們應該廢除這些舊表格改用應用程式。

ex.en: Our company does business with many countries.
ex.zh: 我們公司和許多國家做生意。

ex.en: He wanted to do business in Tainan.
ex.zh: 他想在台南做生意。

ex.en: It is easier to do business online now.
ex.zh: 現在在網路上做生意比較容易了。

do business.en: buy and sell things as a company

ex.en: A short walk can do good for your mind.
ex.zh: 散個短步對你的心情有好處。

ex.en: She wants to do good for the community.
ex.zh: 她想為社區做點好事。

ex.en: A good rest may do good to your body.
ex.zh: 好好休息對你的身體有益。

ex.en: Too much screen time can do harm to your eyes.
ex.zh: 看螢幕太久可能會傷害眼睛。

ex.en: Cruel words can do harm for years.
ex.zh: 傷人的話可能造成多年的傷害。

ex.en: A little stress will not do harm.
ex.zh: 一點壓力不會有害。

ex.en: My son does homework at the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我兒子在廚房的餐桌上寫功課。

ex.en: Students who do homework every day learn faster.
ex.zh: 每天寫功課的學生學得比較快。

ex.en: They did homework together after school.
ex.zh: 他們放學後一起寫功課。

do homework.en: finish work given by a teacher, or prepare before a task

ex.en: A little salt did the trick for the soup.
ex.zh: 加一點鹽，這鍋湯就對味了。

ex.en: Try restarting it; that usually does the trick.
ex.zh: 試試重新開機，通常就能解決。

ex.en: A warm shower should do the trick.
ex.zh: 洗個熱水澡應該就有效。

do the trick.en: work well to solve a problem

ex.en: She did well on the English test.
ex.zh: 她英文考試考得很好。

ex.en: The shop is doing well this year.
ex.zh: 這家店今年生意不錯。

ex.en: I hope you do well in your new job.
ex.zh: 希望你在新工作上表現順利。

do well.en: succeed or perform in a good way

ex.en: Just do your best on the test.
ex.zh: 考試時盡力就好。

ex.en: Do your best, and do not worry about the result.
ex.zh: 盡你所能，別擔心結果。

ex.en: I know you will do your best.
ex.zh: 我知道你會盡全力。

do your best.en: try as hard as you can

ex.en: Even though she is famous, she is very down to earth.
ex.zh: 雖然她很有名，但為人非常平易近人。

ex.en: I like my new boss because he is down to earth.
ex.zh: 我喜歡我的新老闆，因為他很務實又隨和。

down to earth.en: practical, honest and easy to talk to
